items.source: Constructs a new FieldVisitor.
items.translation: 构造一个新的FieldVisitor。

items.source: The field visitor to which this visitor must delegate method calls. May be null.
items.translation: 该访问者必须委派方法调用的目标访问者。可为 null。

items.source: A visitor to visit a Java field. The methods of this class must be called in the following order: ( visitAnnotation | visitTypeAnnotation | visitAttribute )* visitEnd.
items.translation: 访问者用于访问 Java 字段。此类的这些方法必须按以下顺序调用： ( visitAnnotation | visitTypeAnnotation | visitAttribute )* visitEnd。

items.source: The field visitor to which this visitor must delegate method calls.
items.translation: 该访问者必须委托方法调用的目标访问者。

items.source: Visits an annotation of the field.
items.translation: 访问字段的注解。

items.source: Visits a non standard attribute of the field.
items.translation: 访问字段的非标准属性。

items.source: Visits an annotation on the type of the field.
items.translation: 访问字段类型的注解。

items.source:
Visits the end of the field. This method, which is the last one to be called, is used to inform
the visitor that all the annotations and attributes of the field have been visited.
items.translation: 访问字段的末尾。此方法是最后被调用的方法，用于通知访问者该字段的所有注解和属性都已被访问。

items.source: api - the ASM API version implemented by this visitor. Must be one of the ASMx values in Opcodes.
items.translation: api - 此访问者实现的 ASM API 版本。必须是Opcodes中的某个x值，例如 ASMx。

items.source: typeRef - a reference to the annotated type. The sort of this type reference must be TypeReference.FIELD. See TypeReference.
items.translation: typeRef - 对已注解类型的引用。此类型引用的类型必须为TypeReference.FIELD。参见TypeReference。

items.source: fieldVisitor - the field visitor to which this visitor must delegate method calls. May be null.
items.translation: fieldVisitor - 此访问者必须向其委派方法调用的字段访问者。可能为 null。

items.source: descriptor - the class descriptor of the annotation class.
items.translation: descriptor - 注解类的类描述符。

items.source: visible - true if the annotation is visible at runtime.
items.translation: visible - 如果注解在运行时可见，则为 true。

items.source: the field visitor to which this visitor must delegate method calls, or null.
items.translation: 该访问者必须委托方法调用的目标字段访问者，或为 null。

items.source:
a visitor to visit the annotation values, or null if this visitor is not
    interested in visiting this annotation.
items.translation: 访问该注解值的访客，或者如果此访客对该注解不感兴趣则为 null。

items.source: The ASM API version implemented by this visitor. The value of this field must be one of the ASMx values in Opcodes.
items.translation: 此访问者实现的 ASM API 版本。该字段的值必须是Opcodes中的ASMx值之一。

items.source: The ASM API version implemented by this visitor.
items.translation: 此访问者实现的 ASM API 版本。

items.source: Visits the end of the field.
items.translation: 访问字段末尾。

items.source: typePath - the path to the annotated type argument, wildcard bound, array element type, or static inner type within 'typeRef'. May be null if the annotation targets 'typeRef' as a whole.
items.translation: `typePath` - 在 `typeRef` 内到注解类型参数、通配符边界、数组元素类型或静态内部类型的路径。如果注解针对整个 `typeRef`，则可能为 null。

items.source: attribute - an attribute.
items.translation: attribute - 一个属性。

items.source: Eric Bruneton
items.translation: Eric Bruneton

items.source: Field Details
items.translation: 字段详情
